title: 机器学习辅助半导体器件建模的研究线索
excerpt: 从 LDMOS、U-MOSFET 与 TCAD 研究出发，整理机器学习建模器件性能指标的基本路径。
content:
研究线索

机器学习可用于建立器件结构参数与性能指标之间的代理模型，降低参数扫描和优化成本。相关工作覆盖 LDMOS、U-MOSFET、SIPOS 调制漂移区等结构。

后续整理

可以进一步补充数据生成、特征设计、模型选择和 BV/FOM 优化流程。

en.title: Research directions in ML-assisted semiconductor device modeling
en.excerpt: LDMOS, U-MOSFET, and TCAD studies as a basis for learning device-performance models.
en.content:
Research direction

Machine learning can build surrogate relationships between device geometry and performance, reducing parameter-sweep and optimization costs. Related work covers LDMOS, U-MOSFET, and SIPOS-modulated drift regions.

Reading focus

Further notes may address data generation, feature design, model selection, and BV/FOM optimization workflows.
